same_grid_accuracy.interpretation: Unweighted RMS over the identical ordered VTK sample grid, including duplicated DG-face points. These are NOT volume-weighted physical L2 errors or independent spatial/time reference validation. Pressure is reconstructed from conserved fields in FP64; positivity holds only at saved samples.
same_grid_accuracy.profile_interpretation: Near-centerline density is binned in x using the existing shock_qoi reader. Shock/standoff select the largest discrete density gradient; thickness is density range divided by that gradient and cylinder radius. These are sampling-dependent proxies, not shock-fitting or resolved physical widths. Two strip/bin ablations expose extraction sensitivity.
